purpose: Collects one score on a five-point scale: stars for a rating, smileys for a sentiment. Its size and type cascade to every item.

notFor.case: A few options with text labels.
Picking one option from a list of labelled choices.

Default.meaning: The chosen score (1–5) is set by the person or preset by the app.
Default.visual: Five RatingGroupItems; a star group fills every star up to the chosen one; each item draws its own state.

a11y.role: radiogroup, each item radio with aria-checked and a label ("4 of 5 stars", "Good")
a11y.keyboard: One tab stop (the checked option); disabled options are skipped. Arrow Right / Down moves to the next option and selects it, Arrow Left / Up the previous (both wrap); Home / End go to the first / last.
notes: Name the group by its visible question.

openQuestions: There is no read-only or disabled group, only disabled items. How is a rating shown that cannot be changed (an average)?
Can the person clear a rating once chosen? The contract does not say.
